limitations: Conditional conversion diagnostics know actual regional votes. They do not validate the full forecast pipeline or polling windows.
Only four election transitions and nine final-poll elections inform the production baseline.
Historical conditional draws reproduce the Gaussian audit experiment; new model components require extending this experiment before claiming validation.
Current-config reliability uses rounded deployed scales; the original audit used 4.9029 and 0.3818.

methods.national: Leave one election out; election-weighted RMS of centring-corrected misses; 1.645 Gaussian band; top-two covariance from (I-q1^T)D(I-q1^T)^T.
methods.reliability: Same conditional model, independent Monte Carlo batches per seat; bins exclude zero-probability non-winners; favourite threshold >=0.95; multiclass Brier summed per seat.
methods.seat_totals: Perfect actual regional swing; shared zero-centred lambda; independent centred Gaussian seat errors; refit on other pairs; top five actual parties per election; linear 5/50/95 quantiles.
methods.tails: Pooled centring-corrected residuals after each pair's fitted lambda; population excess kurtosis; zero-centred Gaussian tail thresholds.

replay.method: Actual runtime draw_errors/project_seats_vectorised on frozen saved inputs; current settings. Binomial SE for majority and hung; sample SE for tie-split largest-party credit. Five independent seeds measure majority-odds spread.
